notes.title: Pre-Alpha Patch is live!
notes.content:
Hello all!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923273/11b708a232eb5d319c9c9d96d42380685cc0ec5d.png

It's been a week and we have listened to all of you, there's been tremendous feedback from the community and we want to thank you for playing our game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923273/8ef744bf224118779ed059860a4eb24f91b5ae69.gif

We took your feedback to heart, and this week we are releasing our first Pre-Alpha patch! It includes a few Quality of Life (QOL) changes as well as some major bug fixes, as well as a few small enhancements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923273/e33d3ec224db5b7feacddf6a0bb42338dcc42920.gif

This list was created by YOU, our community. Please let us know how we can make this better.

[previewyoutube=lu_OEznoht0;full][/previewyoutube]

Pre-Alpha Patch 1 Notes for June 28, 2024

Increase the drop rate of loot in Sandbox, this includes health, ammo, and components
Allow Ammo Pickup even when the DART rifle is not equipped
Added a Music Volume Slider, adjust Sound Effects and Music independently
Enemies will do different amounts of damage
Main Menu Character Display
Corrected impact sound of player damage
Added a sword swing sound effect


If you have issues with the update being pushed from Steam please let us know, we are learning how Steam works as we go.

Have a great week!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923273/7eb66414f64c549a4abfa25d9445f2d2d225934b.png

notes.title: Pre-Alpha Is Now Available!
notes.content:
https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GFHZH3yWMAAP6DF?format=jpg&name=large

After 16 months of development, we are ready to share our early Pre-Alpha for Spookville: Cabin Escape with YOU.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923273/10b927a88044375cfb37bb4853441653971f7664.png

What started as a passion project between father and son during cold weekends when we were stuck indoors has turned into a living world. Taking inspiration from our family’s small remote cabin and Cohen’s large imagination, we created this interactive story for you to enjoy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923273/d713f049c44af3fc02cf4aabf5064c5d057f875e.png

What is Pre-Alpha?
The state of a project being in Pre-Alpha means the complex systems are in place but there will be bugs, glitches, and incomplete gameplay. We make ourselves vulnerable, this is not a finished project, but we want feedback from you, like:
how can we improve the combat
what sound effects are missing
Any game-breaking bugs

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923273/9a3abdd04472a4ed9e959ab28b513c52acc735e4.jpg

What is included in this build?
This early build includes the tutorial level that introduces you to the world of Spookville and a sandbox mode, a wave-spawning defend your cabin type gameplay.

Where can I offer feedback?
This is priority number 1, we want to open the door for all types of feedback! The quickest place to get ahold of us is via our Discord. We also have opened up a board where you can tell us in our known issues list and which bugs or features should be prioritized.

Discord: https://discord.gg/hAxbTC6U 
Notion: Known-Issues List 
IndieDB: https://www.indiedb.com/games/spookville-cabin-escape 
Itch.io: https://indiescapegames.itch.io/spookville-cabin-escape 
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/IndieScapeGames/ 
Twitter: https://twitter.com/indiescapegames 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923273/4912e92c2ea23a5d8f47e09acf55485aecfe1012.png

How frequently will new builds be made?
This is dependent on the feedback we receive, but currently the goal is every Friday (1 week) or every other Friday (2 weeks) a new build will be made no matter how big or small. Updates will be announced in all of our social media.
